findings.highlight: he states it even more matter-of-factly
findings.evidenceJa: 彼の簡潔さはそれを上回っている
findings.explanation: The pointed comparison between Rin’s brevity and Archer’s still greater terseness is blurred.

findings.highlight: your charm is hard to understand
findings.governingReading: your cuteness is difficult to perceive
findings.explanation: Archer’s final teasing category repeats charm instead of distinguishing elusive cuteness from sex appeal and elegance.

findings.evidenceJa: 無感情に振る舞うアーチャーなど
findings.explanation: A description of Archer’s deliberate manner becomes a claim about an unspecified person’s nature.

findings.highlight: if you knew her from your previous life
findings.evidenceJa: 前世からの因縁にしろ何にせよ
findings.governingReading: whether it is some entanglement from a previous life or whatever else
findings.explanation: Rin’s deliberately broad speculation is narrowed to prior acquaintance.

findings.highlight: He must have been self-conscious of it
findings.evidenceJa: どうやら自覚はあったらしい
findings.governingReading: apparently he was aware of it
findings.explanation: Awareness of his own weakness becomes embarrassment or anxious self-consciousness.

findings.evidenceJa: とって付けただけの台詞、本心ではない言葉だ
findings.governingReading: the line was merely tacked on and was not what she truly felt
findings.explanation: The English omits the narration’s explicit judgment that Rin’s disappointment is insincere.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーから貰っていた治癒能力
findings.governingReading: the healing ability he had received from Saber
findings.explanation: A transferred benefit of the contract is mislabeled as Saber’s own self-healing power.

findings.evidenceJa: 食事ぐらいはできるようになる
findings.governingReading: be able at least to eat
findings.explanation: The prognosis gains unsupported mobility; Rin only says he should become able to eat.
Archer’s practical instruction to defeat Caster is sharpened into an explicit command to kill her.

findings.highlight: The second Command Spell can be lifted off me now, right?
findings.evidenceJa: 二つ目の令呪は、これで解約という事だ
findings.governingReading: this means the second Command Spell you used is thereby canceled
findings.explanation: Archer’s assertion about the promise’s cancellation becomes a question about magically removing a Command Spell.

findings.evidenceJa: 迷いながらも彼女はそう断言する
findings.governingReading: though hesitant, she declares it categorically
findings.explanation: Rin’s visible uncertainty is replaced by stubbornness.

findings.highlight: What can he reply to that?
findings.evidenceJa: どんな反旗を翻せるというのか
findings.governingReading: what sort of rebellion could he possibly raise against that?
findings.explanation: The narration’s master–Servant resistance metaphor is flattened into ordinary verbal reply.

findings.governingReading: she gives a hmph through her nose
findings.explanation: Rin’s dismissive snort is changed into laughter.
